# TradingAlgo

> TradingAlgo Mosaic is a quantitative portfolio research service by Domenico D'Errico. For each of seven markets (USA100, Nasdaq100, Europe50, Germany40, Italy40, UK100, Australia50) it publishes a model portfolio of five stocks selected by transparent rules, with a risk-aware hedge and published validation. It is research and education, not personalised investment advice.

## Start here
- [Home](https://tradingalgo.it/): what TradingAlgo Mosaic is and how the research is organised
- [What is TradingAlgo Mosaic](https://tradingalgo.it/tradingalgo-mosaic.html): the portfolio construction framework
- [Framework](https://tradingalgo.it/framework.html): selection, trend evaluation and diversification rules
- [Validation](https://tradingalgo.it/validation.html): how portfolio results are validated against benchmarks
- [FAQ](https://tradingalgo.it/faq.html): allocation, hedging, rebalancing, subscriptions and the free trial
- [Pricing](https://tradingalgo.it/pricing.html)
